name: phil/incident-mode
description: A standalone incident mode: named presets that suspend sign-ups, invitations, new messages or everything but reading, a duration required on every activation, automatic lifting at the end, manual lifting and a journal; moderation offers it when both are installed.

suggest.doctrine/dbal: To keep the activations in a database with DbalActivationStore
suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the table of the activations to the schema the ORM generates, with IncidentSchemaListener
suggest.symfony/messenger: To lift an incident at its end by a delayed message, with MessengerLiftScheduler and its handlers
